from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, QuantumRegister

def solve(n: int) -> QuantumCircuit:
    x, y = QuantumRegister(n), QuantumRegister(1)
    qc = QuantumCircuit(x, y)

    if n <= 1:
        qc.cx(x[0], y[0])
        return qc

    # accumulate parity of x into x[n-1]
    for i in range(n - 1):
        qc.cx(x[i], x[i + 1])

    # copy the accumulated parity to y
    qc.cx(x[n - 1], y[0])

    # uncompute the accumulation so x is restored
    for i in range(n - 2, -1, -1):
        qc.cx(x[i], x[i + 1])

    return qc

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, QuantumRegister

def solve(n: int) -> QuantumCircuit:
    x, y = QuantumRegister(n), QuantumRegister(1)
    qc = QuantumCircuit(x, y)

    # y <- y XOR x0 XOR x1 ... XOR x{n-1}
    # a CNOT from each x[i] to y accumulates the parity
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        qc.cx(x[i], y[0])
        i += 1

    return qc

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, QuantumRegister

def solve(n: int) -> QuantumCircuit:
    x, y = QuantumRegister(n), QuantumRegister(1)
    qc = QuantumCircuit(x, y)

    # |x>|y> -> |x>|y xor parity(x)>
    # H_y  CZ(x_i,y)  H_y  = X^{parity(x)} on y
    qc.h(y[0])
    for i in range(n):
        qc.cz(x[i], y[0])
    qc.h(y[0])

    return qc
